prose: Epic Games confirmed it is using AI tools to develop code and features for Unreal Engine, including core engine components such as the D3D12 rendering layer, following CEO Tim Sweeney's announced 'huge pivot' toward AI tools.
highlights: Epic using AI tools on Unreal Engine code and features
Includes core components like the D3D12 rendering layer
Follows Tim Sweeney's 'huge pivot' toward AI tooling
